original_query: What is the biggest reason why users sometimes choose not to use the applications, data of which are not mostly trusted by 8% users?

summaries.found_via_query: reasons users avoid apps with untrusted data, based on user trust metrics
summaries.summary: A bar chart titled 'Business Users Do Not Fully Trust Enterprise Data' shows survey results on trust in enterprise BI applications. The majority (67%) trust data in some BI applications but not others, while 24% trust all data fully and 8% mostly do not trust data. The study was conducted by Forrester Consulting for SAP in March 2014, based on 171 business decision-makers.
key_facts: 67% of users trust data in some enterprise BI applications, not others
24% trust all data fully
8% mostly do not trust data in enterprise BI applications
Survey base: 171 business decision-makers
Source: Forrester Consulting for SAP, March 2014
visible_text: Business Users Do Not Fully Trust Enterprise Data
How much do you trust data available in your enterprise BI applications?
Full trust in all data from all enterprise BI applications 24%
Trust data in some enterprise BI applications, not in others 67%
Mostly do not trust data in enterprise BI applications 8%
Base: 171 business decision-makers who influence BI decisions
Source: A commissioned study conducted by Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP, March 2014
